# truenas_ups_config (Resource)

Update UPS Service Configuration.

`powerdown` when enabled, sets UPS to power off after shutting down the system.

`nocommwarntime` is a value in seconds which makes UPS Service wait the specified seconds before alerting that
the Service cannot reach configured UPS.

`shutdowntimer` is a value in seconds which tells the Service to wait specified seconds for the UPS before
initiating a shutdown. This only applies when `shutdown` is set to "BATT".

`shutdowncmd` is the command which is executed to initiate a shutdown. It defaults to "poweroff".

This resource manages existing settings: creating it applies the configured attributes, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of this UPS configuration.
- `driver` (String) UPS driver name that handles communication with the specific UPS hardware model.
- `extrausers` (String) Additional user configurations for UPS monitoring access.
- `hostsync` (Number) Maximum seconds to wait for other systems to shutdown before continuing.
- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier name for this UPS device within the monitoring system.
- `mode` (String) Operating mode.
* `MASTER` controls the UPS directly
* `SLAVE` monitors remotely
- `monpwd` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password for UPS monitoring authentication (required for updates).
- `monpwd_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `monpwd` again. Terraform never stores `monpwd`.
- `monuser` (String) Username for UPS monitoring authentication.
- `nocommwarntime` (Number) Seconds to wait before warning about communication loss with UPS. `null` for default.
- `options` (String) Additional configuration options passed to the UPS driver.
- `optionsupsd` (String) Additional configuration options for the UPS daemon.
- `port` (String) Serial port or device path for UPS communication.
- `powerdown` (Boolean) Whether the UPS should power down after completing the shutdown sequence.
- `remotehost` (String) Hostname or IP address of remote UPS server when operating in SLAVE mode.
- `remoteport` (Number) Network port for communicating with remote UPS monitoring systems.
- `rmonitor` (Boolean) Whether to enable remote monitoring of the UPS status over the network.
- `shutdown` (String) Shutdown trigger condition: LOWBATT on low battery, BATT when on battery power.
- `shutdowncmd` (String) Custom command to execute during UPS shutdown sequence. `null` for default.
- `shutdowntimer` (Number) Seconds to wait after initiating shutdown before forcing power off.

### Read-Only

- `complete_identifier` (String) Complete UPS identifier including hostname for network monitoring.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_ups_config.this
  provider = truenas
  id       = "ups"
}
```
